en: A thing long expected takes the form of the unexpected when at last it comes.
zh: 期待已久的事，真正到来时，反倒像是意料之外。
line: A thing long expected takes the form of the unexpected when at last it comes. — Mark Twain

word.zh: n. 市郊住宅区，郊区，边缘
word.ex: The other day something horrible happened in a Tokyo suburb.
word.exzh: 前几天，东京郊外发生了件可怕的事情。
